decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 44 instructions, 176-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xa607748c.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 5/5 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering ghost-count limits, callback and reset paths.
